notable.name: French
notable.note: no official status but spoken by roughly half the population as a second language; used widely in business, science, and education

terrainDescription.zh: 北部與東部沿海屬地中海型氣候，特勒平原是主要農業區，南部則逐漸轉為撒哈拉沙漠邊緣地帶。
terrainDescription.en: A Mediterranean climate along the north and east coasts, with the Tell region forming the main agricultural belt, transitioning to Sahara-fringe desert in the south.

plate.color: white text on a black background with the Arabic word "تونس" (Tunisia) — Tunisia is the only African country with black license plates, a highly distinctive clue

historicalContext.zh: 突尼西亞憲法明定阿拉伯語為唯一官方語言，但法語因殖民歷史因素仍是重要的社會與專業領域語言，約半數人口能以法語作為第二語言溝通；柏柏爾語僅在南部少數村落與傑爾巴島零星使用。
historicalContext.en: Tunisia's constitution names Arabic as the sole official language, but French remains an important language of social prestige and professional life due to colonial history, spoken as a second language by roughly half the population. Berber survives only in a handful of southern villages and on Djerba island.
